about.body: Fixes the layout and case of text you just typed. You set the boundary: the first press takes the last word, the second takes everything you typed.
autostart.failed.body: Windows refused to create or remove the startup task.
autostart.failed.hint: Try the “Normal” mode — it works through the registry and needs no system services.
autostart.failed.title: Could not set up autostart
autostart.task.description: Starts oops at logon, with no delay.

crash.body: Something happened that the app did not anticipate. Hotkeys may have stopped working — please restart it.
crash.hint: If this keeps happening, send a report: it arrives with the error description, so we do not have to guess.
crash.missing.body: The program could not find one of its own files — it was deleted from disk while the program was running. A temporary-files cleanup is the usual cause.
crash.missing.hint: Restart the program: it lays its files out again on startup. If it keeps happening, exclude the oops folder from automatic disk cleanup.
crash.title: oops crashed unexpectedly
feedback.browserFailed: Could not open the browser. Write manually: {0}
feedback.hint.empty: Describe it in your own words — the app and Windows versions are filled in automatically.
feedback.hint.ready: A GitHub page will open with the text already filled in — you just press Submit. A GitHub account is required.
feedback.hint.required: Write a couple of words first about what happened or what is missing.
feedback.title: Something wrong, or an idea?
feedback.window.title: Feedback
hook.failed.body: Hotkeys cannot work without it, so the app will not start.
hook.failed.hint: Usually another app with global hotkeys is in the way (Punto Switcher, a layout manager, an anti-cheat). Close it and try again.
hook.failed.title: Could not capture the keyboard
hotkey.clash.body: Layout and case cannot share one combination: only the first will fire, the second stays silent without a single sign.
hotkey.clash.hint: Assign different ones — for example Ctrl + Win for layout and Alt + Win for case.
hotkey.clash.title: Hotkeys are identical
hotkey.replace.hint: Find and replace, regular expressions included
hotkey.translate.hint: RU → EN and back, on this machine

model.err.noChecksum: No checksum is defined for “{0}” — it must not be downloaded.
model.err.untrustedUrl: “{0}” is offered from an untrusted address.
models.failed.body: The download was interrupted. What arrived is kept — the next attempt resumes from the same place.
models.failed.hint: Check your connection and press “Download” again.
models.failed.title: Could not download the models
news.1_0.case.body: UPPER ↔ lower by the same logic: first press for the last word, second for everything you typed.
news.1_0.case.title: Case switching
news.1_0.layout.body: Typed something in the wrong layout — press the shortcut. The first press fixes the last word, the second (within two seconds) fixes everything you typed. The app never guesses the boundary: you set it with the number of presses.
news.1_0.layout.title: Fixing the keyboard layout
news.1_0.selection.body: If you typed nothing but selected existing text with the mouse, both shortcuts convert the selection as a whole. The clipboard is left untouched — your Win+V history stays clean.
news.1_0.selection.title: Working with a selection
news.1_1.caseHotkey.body: The case shortcut stayed silent while Alt was held: Windows delivered the characters as system ones and input fields ignored them. Modifiers are now cleared before every character.
news.1_1.caseHotkey.title: Case switching finally works
news.1_1.darkTheme.body: Windows follow the Windows dark theme, including the title bar and the tray menu.
news.1_1.darkTheme.title: Dark theme
news.1_1.welcome.body: On first start the app explains how the expanding-scope model works and offers to pick your shortcuts. Before that it appeared to do nothing at all and was taken for broken.
news.1_1.welcome.title: First-run wizard
news.1_2.checksum.body: The downloaded installer is checked against the published SHA-256 before it runs. If it does not match, the file is deleted rather than launched.
news.1_2.checksum.title: Updates are verified by checksum
news.1_2.errors.body: Instead of system dialogs — our own: what happened, what to do about it, and the technical details behind a link, ready to copy or send in one click.
news.1_2.errors.title: Error messages that make sense
news.1_2.fastTyping.body: A corrected phrase used to be typed one character at a time and took about a second. Now it takes tens of milliseconds. If some application loses characters, the old behaviour is available in settings as “Type slowly, one character at a time”.
news.1_2.fastTyping.title: Text is rewritten instantly
news.1_2_1.releaseNotes.body: The update window shows the release description as plain text instead of markup like “## What's Changed” and pull request links.
news.1_2_1.releaseNotes.title: Readable release notes
news.1_2_2.hotkeyField.body: The shortcut field in settings is wider: the third key used to be cut off.
news.1_2_2.hotkeyField.title: Three-key shortcuts fit
news.1_2_3.notes.body: Release notes are no longer selected in full when the window opens — it used to greet you with a wall of blue.
news.1_2_3.notes.title: The update window opens calmly
news.1_3.feedback.body: The tray menu got a “Report a problem” item: describe what happened and a pre-filled form opens on GitHub — the version and your system are filled in for you.
news.1_3.feedback.title: Report a problem from the tray
news.1_3.layout.body: Every control in the settings window was rewritten as our own: at 125–150 % display scaling labels and buttons used to be cut off at the edge.
news.1_3.layout.title: The interface stopped clipping text
news.2_0.language.body: Russian and English, switched on the fly. The Windows language is used by default.
news.2_0.language.title: Interface language
news.2_0.models.body: Translation and voice input ask for their models the first time you turn them on — with progress, cancellation and resume after an interruption. You can remove them and free the space in the same place.
news.2_0.models.title: Models download once
news.2_0.translate.body: Translates what you typed, or the selection, right in the input field. The direction is chosen from the text. It runs on your machine, offline: download the models first in Settings, on the “Behaviour” tab.
news.2_0.translate.title: RU ↔ EN translation
news.2_0.voice.body: Press the shortcut and speak; press it again to finish. Text appears while you speak and is refined as it goes, with a panel at the bottom of the screen showing the transcript. Recognition runs on your machine — the audio is never sent anywhere and never written to disk.
news.2_0.voice.title: Voice input
news.2_0_1.theme.body: Settings → “General”: Auto, Light, Dark. Auto follows the Windows theme and picks up changes without a restart.
news.2_0_1.theme.title: Colour theme
news.2_1.replace.body: Select a piece of text and press the shortcut — a find and replace window opens. Plain search, regular expressions, match case and whole words. The result and the number of replacements are visible before anything is typed.
news.2_1.replace.title: Replace in selected text
news.2_1.wizard.body: In the same window: ready-made rules for common tasks — collapse double spaces, collapse blank lines, typographic quotes, strip HTML tags. Plus building blocks (“digits”, “spaces”, “line start”) that go into the search field and switch on regular expression mode for you.
news.2_1.wizard.title: Expression wizard
news.2_2.autostart.body: Settings → “General” → “Start with Windows”: the “Early” mode registers a logon task with no delay. Windows deliberately staggers ordinary startup entries by nearly ten seconds, and the shortcuts do nothing for all of it.
news.2_2.autostart.title: Start with Windows, ahead of the rest
news.2_2.selection.body: Select text with the mouse and press the shortcut: every word is converted, with no second-guessing. You drew the boundary yourself, and a selection has no second press that could change the verdict.
news.2_2.selection.title: A selection is converted whole
news.2_2.smart.body: Press the shortcut on text you have typed: the direction is now chosen for each word separately, so “Z djn [jxe gjckfnm уьфшд” becomes “Я вот хочу послать email” in one go. A word that already looks real is left alone: “password” inside a Russian phrase stays “password”.
news.2_2.smart.title: Words in the other language survive
news.2_2.stop.body: If the text starts going somewhere it should not, click the mouse or press Esc and it stops. Switching to another window stops it on its own. A selection larger than a page is now refused outright, and the program says so.
news.2_2.stop.title: Typing can be stopped
news.header.hint: Versions on the left, what they brought on the right. The shortcuts shown are the ones you have right now.
news.window.title: What's new

welcome.hotkeys.subtitle: A combination can be modifiers only (Ctrl + Win) or include a regular key, for example Ctrl + Alt + X. All of it can be changed later in settings.
welcome.hotkeys.title: Hotkeys
welcome.how.clipboard: Fixed text is typed by emulating the keyboard and never reaches the clipboard — your Win+V history stays clean.
welcome.how.p1: The app does not guess where you slipped into the wrong layout — you set the boundary by how many times you press the hotkey:
welcome.how.p2: The first press fixes the last word, the second fixes everything you typed. The presses must follow each other within a couple of seconds.
welcome.how.selection: If text is selected with the mouse, the hotkey converts the whole selection.
welcome.intro.subtitle: Fixes the layout and case of text you just typed. Works in every Windows app.
welcome.note.altShift: Alt + Shift cannot be assigned: Windows keeps that combination for layout switching, so it never reaches the app.
welcome.note.tray: The app lives in the tray. Double-click the icon to open settings.
